name: Winter House
description: A minecraft house for winter with a steep slate roof, wood upper floor and a stone wall around the yard. Two storeys plus a walled terrace with its own stairs and a chimney. Mostly wood and stone bricks, cheap to gather. Suits a snowy mountain or taiga base.

subBuilds.description: Break up the grass block and divide the area into two parts.
Remove the slab after placing the trapdoor.
